record.name: Sloan Great Wall
record.notes: The paper gives the wall's run in right ascension twice, as 8.7h to 14h (in the text describing its map) and as 8.7h to 13.7h (in the comparison with the CfA2 wall); the second is used. It splits into two strands between 11.3h and 9.8h. The declination bounds are those of the SDSS slice, which only samples the wall. The equinox of the map is not stated.
